title: The Upanishads — Īśāvāsya study edition

attribution.traditionalLocation: Śukla Yajurveda, Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā 40 (Kāṇva Saṃhitā 40; Mādhyandina VS 40 has 17 mantras in another order)

sources.label: GRETIL, Īśa-Upaniṣad, Kāṇva recension (Sansknet input; mūla checked against Limaye & Vadekar, Eighteen Principal Upaniṣads vol. 1, Poona 1958), via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts
sources.note: The base text. Two corrections, both of spacing or avagraha position; no reading changed.

sources.label: Advaita Sharada (Śṛṅgeri), mūla of Śaṅkara's Īśāvāsyopaniṣad-bhāṣya, via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts
Kāṇva Saṃhitā 40 with svara; Mādhyandina Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā 40 with svara and pada-pāṭha; the mūla of Madhva's and Vedānta Deśika's commentaries — github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: Collated letter by letter; every difference classified in upanishads/isha/edition/corrections.json. Svara shown only from the Kāṇva Saṃhitā witness, as keyed.

sources.label: Śaṅkara, Vedānta Deśika, Madhva (Īśāvāsyopaniṣad-bhāṣyas) and Mahīdhara (on VS 40), via github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: The authorities for the traditional and comparative notes; every Sanskrit quotation is checked against them.

sources.label: Parallel passages from Advaita Sharada mūla files (Gītā, Upaniṣads, Brahmasūtra) and GRETIL (Ṛgveda, Bṛhadāraṇyaka, Māṇḍūkya); Pāṇini's sūtras from github.com/sanskrit/ashtadhyayi
sources.note: Every quoted phrase and every sūtra citation is checked against these.

translation.note: Padaccheda, word tables, translations, explanations, commentary prose and studies were prepared for PaddySpeaks (upanishads/isha/edition/). They are not taken from a published translation; commentary is labelled by its authority.

verification.method: Automated proof: 18 mantras without a gap; text equal to the base witness apart from logged corrections; every letter difference of five witnesses classified; every padaccheda rejoins by sandhi; every commentator quotation, parallel and Pāṇini citation found in its source; every mantra has all fourteen sections.
verification.scope: the text, the collation and the analysis records

knownIssues.summary: Translations, explanations and commentary prose await review by a Sanskrit scholar; readings marked 'Verification required' (Kāṇva Saṃhitā witness in mantras 10 and 16, Madhva's text in 14) need a printed edition.

statusNote: Text machine-verified against six witnesses; analysis machine-checked for its sources; scholarly review pending.
